### Concating Domain3 Horizontally

## Split FLiF and create separate files
```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# Load aligned FASTA
fasta_file <- "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_famsa3diAligned_unsplit.fasta"
seqs <- readAAStringSet(fasta_file)

# Identify sequences ending with "_FliF"
fliF_idx <- grep("_FliF$", names(seqs))

# Prepare containers
split_rbm1 <- AAStringSet()
split_rbm2 <- AAStringSet()
split_rbm3 <- AAStringSet()

# Loop through each FliF sequence
for (i in fliF_idx) {
  seq <- seqs[[i]]
  name_base <- names(seqs)[i]
  
  # Extract RBM1, RBM2, RBM3
  rbm1 <- subseq(seq, start = 218, end = 404)
  rbm2 <- subseq(seq, start = 418, end = 778)
  rbm3 <- subseq(seq, start = 845, end = 1394)
  
  # Add each RBM to its respective container (same names)
  rbm1_entry <- AAStringSet(rbm1)
  names(rbm1_entry) <- name_base
  split_rbm1 <- c(split_rbm1, rbm1_entry)
  
  rbm2_entry <- AAStringSet(rbm2)
  names(rbm2_entry) <- name_base
  split_rbm2 <- c(split_rbm2, rbm2_entry)
  
  rbm3_entry <- AAStringSet(rbm3)
  names(rbm3_entry) <- name_base
  split_rbm3 <- c(split_rbm3, rbm3_entry)
}

# Remove gaps from sequences
split_rbm1 <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(split_rbm1)))
split_rbm2 <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(split_rbm2)))
split_rbm3 <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(split_rbm3)))

# Write to separate FASTA files
writeXStringSet(split_rbm1, "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_FliF_RBM1.fasta")
writeXStringSet(split_rbm2, "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_FliF_RBM2.fasta")
writeXStringSet(split_rbm3, "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_FliF_RBM3.fasta")

```

## Saving Separate SPO files
```{r}
fasta_file <- "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_famsa3diAligned_unsplit.fasta"
seqs <- readAAStringSet(fasta_file)

# === Identify sequences by suffix ===
seqs_H <- seqs[grep("SpoIIIAH$", names(seqs))]
seqs_G <- seqs[grep("SpoIIIAG$", names(seqs))]
seqs_F <- seqs[grep("SpoIIIAF$", names(seqs))]

# === Remove gaps (optional but useful) ===
seqs_H <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(seqs_H)))
seqs_G <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(seqs_G)))
seqs_F <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(seqs_F)))

# === Write to separate files ===
writeXStringSet(seqs_H, "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_SpoIIIAH_RBM2.fasta")
writeXStringSet(seqs_G, "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_SpoIIIAG_RBM3.fasta")
writeXStringSet(seqs_F, "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_SpoIIIAF_RBM2.fasta")
```


## Split T3SS and create separate files
```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# === Load aligned FASTA ===
fasta_file <- "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_famsa3diAligned_unsplit.fasta"
seqs <- readAAStringSet(fasta_file)

# === Identify sequences containing "T3SS" ===
t3ss_idx <- grep("T3SS", names(seqs))

# === Prepare containers for RBM1 and RBM2 ===
split_rbm1 <- AAStringSet()
split_rbm2 <- AAStringSet()

# === Loop through each T3SS sequence ===
for (i in t3ss_idx) {
  seq <- seqs[[i]]
  name_base <- names(seqs)[i]
  
  # Extract RBM1 and RBM2
  rbm1 <- subseq(seq, start = 218, end = 404)
  rbm2 <- subseq(seq, start = 418, end = 778)
  
  # Store with same names
  rbm1_entry <- AAStringSet(rbm1)
  names(rbm1_entry) <- name_base
  split_rbm1 <- c(split_rbm1, rbm1_entry)
  
  rbm2_entry <- AAStringSet(rbm2)
  names(rbm2_entry) <- name_base
  split_rbm2 <- c(split_rbm2, rbm2_entry)
}

# === Remove gaps ===
split_rbm1 <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(split_rbm1)))
split_rbm2 <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(split_rbm2)))

# === Write only RBM1 and RBM2 sequences to files ===
writeXStringSet(split_rbm1, "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_T3SS_RBM1.fasta")
writeXStringSet(split_rbm2, "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_T3SS_RBM2.fasta")
```

## Concat RBM1, RBM2, RBM3
```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# === Directory containing your FASTA files ===
input_dir <- "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge"

# === Find all FASTA files by suffix ===
rbm1_files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "RBM1\\.fasta$", full.names = TRUE)
rbm2_files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "RBM2\\.fasta$", full.names = TRUE)
rbm3_files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "RBM3\\.fasta$", full.names = TRUE)

# === Helper function to read and combine FASTAs ===
combine_fastas <- function(file_list) {
  all_seqs <- AAStringSet()
  for (f in file_list) {
    seqs <- readAAStringSet(f)
    all_seqs <- c(all_seqs, seqs)
  }
  return(all_seqs)
}

# === Combine and save ===
if (length(rbm1_files) > 0) {
  combined_rbm1 <- combine_fastas(rbm1_files)
  writeXStringSet(combined_rbm1, file.path(input_dir, "3di_RBM1.fasta"))
}

if (length(rbm2_files) > 0) {
  combined_rbm2 <- combine_fastas(rbm2_files)
  writeXStringSet(combined_rbm2, file.path(input_dir, "3di_RBM2.fasta"))
}

if (length(rbm3_files) > 0) {
  combined_rbm3 <- combine_fastas(rbm3_files)
  writeXStringSet(combined_rbm3, file.path(input_dir, "3di_RBM3.fasta"))
}

```

# Align the 3di sequences, using famsa3di
```{bash}

famsa3di ./Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM1.fasta ./Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM1_famsa3dialigned.fasta
famsa3di ./Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM2.fasta ./Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM2_famsa3dialigned.fasta
famsa3di ./Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM3.fasta ./Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM3_famsa3dialigned.fasta

```

```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# === Input files (edit paths) ===
file1 <- "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM1_famsa3dialigned.fasta"
file2 <- "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM2_famsa3dialigned.fasta"

# === Read sequences ===
seqs1 <- readAAStringSet(file1)
seqs2 <- readAAStringSet(file2)

# === Convert to named character vectors ===
seqs1_vec <- setNames(as.character(seqs1), names(seqs1))
seqs2_vec <- setNames(as.character(seqs2), names(seqs2))

# === Combine all sequence names ===
all_names <- unique(c(names(seqs1_vec), names(seqs2_vec)))

# === Determine max lengths for padding ===
maxlen1 <- max(nchar(seqs1_vec))
maxlen2 <- max(nchar(seqs2_vec))

# === Initialize result ===
combined_vec <- character(length(all_names))
names(combined_vec) <- all_names

# === Merge horizontally (with gap-fill if missing) ===
for (n in all_names) {
  seq1 <- if (n %in% names(seqs1_vec)) seqs1_vec[[n]] else paste0(rep("-", maxlen1), collapse = "")
  seq2 <- if (n %in% names(seqs2_vec)) seqs2_vec[[n]] else paste0(rep("-", maxlen2), collapse = "")
  
  combined_vec[[n]] <- paste0(seq1, seq2)
}

# === Convert back to AAStringSet ===
combined_set <- AAStringSet(combined_vec)

# === Write output ===
output_file <- "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM1_2_famsa3dialigned.fasta"
writeXStringSet(combined_set, output_file)



```

```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# === Input files ===
file1 <- "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM1_2_famsa3dialigned.fasta"
file2 <- "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM3_famsa3dialigned.fasta"

# === Read sequences ===
seqs1 <- readAAStringSet(file1)
seqs2 <- readAAStringSet(file2)

# === Convert to named character vectors ===
seqs1_vec <- setNames(as.character(seqs1), names(seqs1))
seqs2_vec <- setNames(as.character(seqs2), names(seqs2))

# === Identify special pairs ===
names1_h <- grep("SpoIIIAF$", names(seqs1_vec), value = TRUE)
names2_g <- grep("SpoIIIAG$", names(seqs2_vec), value = TRUE)

# === Determine max lengths for padding ===
maxlen1 <- max(nchar(seqs1_vec))
maxlen2 <- max(nchar(seqs2_vec))

# === Initialize result storage ===
combined_vec <- list()
used_seq2 <- character()  # to track used SpoIIIAG sequences

# === Special concatenation rule ===
for (n1 in names1_h) {
  if (length(names2_g) > 0) {
    n2 <- names2_g[1]  # take first available SpoIIIAG
    seq1 <- seqs1_vec[[n1]]
    seq2 <- seqs2_vec[[n2]]
    
    new_name <- paste0(n1, "_", n2)
    combined_vec[[new_name]] <- paste0(seq1, seq2)
    
    # mark SpoIIIAG as used
    used_seq2 <- c(used_seq2, n2)
    # remove used one from list
    names2_g <- setdiff(names2_g, n2)
  } else {
    # if no SpoIIIAG left, just keep SpoIIIAH alone
    combined_vec[[n1]] <- seqs1_vec[[n1]]
  }
}

# === Remaining normal sequences ===
remaining1 <- setdiff(names(seqs1_vec), names1_h)
remaining2 <- setdiff(names(seqs2_vec), used_seq2)

# === Combine all sequence names ===
all_names <- unique(c(remaining1, remaining2))

# === Merge horizontally (with gap-fill if missing) ===
for (n in all_names) {
  seq1 <- if (n %in% names(seqs1_vec)) seqs1_vec[[n]] else paste0(rep("-", maxlen1), collapse = "")
  seq2 <- if (n %in% names(seqs2_vec)) seqs2_vec[[n]] else paste0(rep("-", maxlen2), collapse = "")
  
  combined_vec[[n]] <- paste0(seq1, seq2)
}

# === Convert to AAStringSet and write ===
combined_set <- AAStringSet(unlist(combined_vec))
output_file <- "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned.fasta"
writeXStringSet(combined_set, output_file)

```

trimal -in ./Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned.fasta -out ./Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned_trim35.fasta -gt 0.35 -colnumbering | tee ./Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned_trim35_cols.txt

## Reordering_ALignment
```{r}
tr_renamed <- ape::read.tree("Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_nj/outTree_unrooted.nwk") ## renamed tree file
plotTree(tr_renamed)
desired_order <- tr_renamed$tip.label[order((get("last_plot.phylo", envir = .PlotPhyloEnv)$yy[1:Ntip(tr_renamed)]))]
fasta_file <- seqinr::read.fasta (file = "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_nj/input.fa.final_tree.used_alg.fa") ## renamed fasta file
fasta_ids <-names(fasta_file)
tip_ids <- desired_order
reordered_fasta <- fasta_file[(match(tip_ids, fasta_ids))]
seqinr::write.fasta(sequences = reordered_fasta, names=desired_order, file.out = "Data/11_SpoAF_AG_merge/3di_nj/input.fa.final_tree.used_alg_reordered.fa") ## out file  - renamed, reordered fasta file
```
